notes.subject: גנבתי
notes.rationale: Klostu ol man i tanim olsem 'ol stilim em' (samting i stol), tasol YLT i ridim olsem 'ol giamanim mi' — hap tok bilong man i wok long basket

notes.subject: גנבתי ... וגנבתי
notes.rationale: Wanpela tok i kamap tupela taim — dei na nait — olsem singaut bilong tok; Tok Pisin i holim pasin wankain

notes.subject: mi karim pe
notes.rationale: אחטנה (tingting long חטא 'bagarapim') em i bilong karim pe bilong samting i lus

translation: Ol samting ol animal i kaimapim, mi no bringim i kam long yu; mi yet mi karim pe long ⟨em⟩ — long han bilong mi yu askim ⟨em⟩; ol stilim ⟨em⟩ long dei, na ol stilim ⟨em⟩ long nait.

tokens.gloss: Ol samting ol animal i kaimapim
